configurations.converter: FAIL-risk: fresh 2.9V < 3.0V cold start; EOD at 2.0V run floor
marginal: 2.0V floor cuts at 1.0V/cell, load sag

converter.efficiency_basis: TI datasheet Vo=5V curves ~88-92% at VIN 3-5V, Iout ~0.3A; 0.85 adds margin

radio_option_delta: Options (i) nRF24+RP2040 and (ii-a) nRF52 co-processor are runtime-identical at model precision (<1% daily energy): RP2040 owns sensing and sets the sleep floor in both; radio sleep differs by ~1 uA class (nRF24 PD 0.9 uA vs nRF52 ~2 uA).

sensitivity.dominant_assumption: active-typing hours at continuous scan (72% of daily load energy)

study: AA/AAA battery sizing (PO decision 2026-11-18: AA or AAA, user-replaceable, no in-device charging)

verdict.ranking_note: (i) still leads; AA/AAA widens its cost lead (cells become a recurring consumable; (ii-a) premium buys no runtime). Flip would require nRF52 owning burst timing + HALL rail with RP2040 power-gated - outside both studied options.
verdict.week_binding: best pack 9.27 Wh (4xAA alkaline) / 11.17 Wh (eneloop pro) vs 23.3 Wh needed; daily energy 4.65 Wh is the binding number
